messages:
Marta L: Spun up a consolidated remediation tracker for recurring metering variance incidents - goal: single source for backfill status, invoice corrections, and postmortem action items. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/MP-2026-remediation-tracker
Ibrahim K: Good call. We keep re-running the same manual steps across incidents. This tracker should capture CSV artifacts, validation checksums, and customer comms drafts.
Chen W: I can standardize the CSV output and validation steps. Proposed canonical CSV columns: account_id, billing_period_start, billing_period_end, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, token_delta, credit_usd, validation_checksum.
Asha P: I'll own the invoices + comms workflow. Ask engineering for the CSV + a short verification report (top 20 diffs) before I generate credits. We should also tag accounts by credit tier so comms vary automatically.
Priyanka (acct): Accounting: set policy: credits > $200 require manager sign-off and > $1,500 require finance + legal review. Also need an audit line item in the ledger for Q-consolidation.
billing-bot: JIRA-5123 created: "Consolidated remediation tracker - billing variance". Labels: billing, meta, automation. Priority: P2.
Marta L: Action owners I suggest: engineering backfill + CSV -> Ibrahim K -> due 2026-04-10; CSV standardization & checksum -> Chen W -> due 2026-04-09; invoice corrections & segmented comms -> Asha P -> due 2026-04-14; accounting sign-off policy & ledger entry -> Priyanka -> due 2026-04-12.
Ibrahim K: Plan: implement idempotent backfill job with artifacts uploaded to the tracker bucket. Dry-run on staging within 24h of patch, prod run after verification. Will include quick sanity query used for validation:
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as corrected_tokens
FROM metering_events_backfilled
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
Will attach sample diff + log checksums.
Chen W: I'll add a small script to compute validation_checksum (md5 of CSV rows) and a lightweight validator that flags >1% delta anomalies for manual review.
Asha P: Communication plan: automated email for credits <$100, templated outreach for $100-$1,500, and manual outreach for >$1,500. Draft templates by 2026-04-11. Please include an FAQ bullet on "why this happened" and "how we calculated the credit."
Priyanka (acct): Also request that every credit has a memo field with JIRA id and remediation tracker URL for auditability.
Marta L: Monitoring: add a single alert rule that triggers when "late_event_rate" > threshold OR when daily backfill deltas exceed baseline. Mateo want to own alert PR? @Ibrahim will coordinate with Mateo.
Ibrahim K: Will coordinate with Mateo and open PR for the alert by 2026-04-08. Also proposing a weekly cadence check for 8 weeks post-fix.
Marta L: We'll have a short sync 2026-04-13 10:00 PT to confirm CSV readiness and draft emails. If any blocker, post in this thread and escalate to oncall. :thumbsup:
